about_the_game:
Swing your paddles and overcome the loooooong parcour. In "Paddle Paddle Paddle" you have to paddle (who would have expected...), avoid obstacles and just don't fall into the lava... At the end of the hard and rocky path an incredible prize awaits you (maybe).

You can play the game alone or with a friend. Here you either control both paddles or share control with your game partner. Frustration and mistakes are inevitable here!

Information about the Demo:
The demo contains a small demo level that's quite hard already! The Demo has an estimated playtime of an hour and already offers several elements such as moving platforms, thin paths with tight turns, pirate ships, and much more! The demo already features local and online multiplayer, but I recommend Steam Remote Play Together if you want to play with friends. The demo contains a fiery lava area, and the full game will feature a large level with various zones (jungle, volcano, etc.). I hope the demo gives you a little taste of what's to come, and I wish you lots of fun paddling!

The demo is a separate level and will not appear in the full game! So you can play through the demo without any problems and still start the full-game blind. However, the menus and paddle-mechanic are final now and wont change until the full-game launches. The graphic style is also final in the demo.


Demo Features:
-> Physics-based paddling like in real life (I think)
-> High frustration factor when falling down (friendships could suffer)
-> Local and Online Coop is possible
-> Speedrun timer in the game
-> One giant level with different biomes
-> Input Rebinding option in the Settings
-> Checkpoints can be activated in the Settings
-> Different Paddle-Type (Realistic or Arcade) in the Settings

Information about the development:
My name is Mateo and I am the 22 year old solo developer of the game. The idea for "Paddle Paddle Paddle" came to me while I was taking a shower and I wanted to mix an only-up like parkour with a physics-based paddle boat mechanic. The whole video game was a little experiment and will be developed and released within a month. I hope you still have fun (and hopefully not too much frustration) with the game. This Demo was completely developed and released within 2 weeks.
